implementation.role_lifecycle: Ordinary role scope exits share reference cleanup; deletion atomically clears four relation families/entity/current user versions, preserving shared menus and permissions.
implementation.current_management_facts: Safe sorted Identity locking projection plus actual role dependency union/current recheck; explicit management/current readers are separate from ordinary repeatable-read snapshots.
implementation.organization_lifecycle: Bulk/per-user memberships and custom references consume the C4 current hierarchy barrier; current inactive/memberless ordinary custom refs block deletion.
implementation.navigation_api: All mapped production reference participants use target locks/current reads. Dynamic API/menu/code-inspection dependencies are gathered before ordered acquisition and revalidated; changed sets conflict with no own writes and no S3 propagation expansion.
implementation.identity_and_seed: Managed identity writes recheck current target/protection/scope in transaction. Seed existing-target/link reads lock within passed transaction, propagate lookup failure and preserve active admin passwords.
implementation.outer_commit_hooks: Nested Run joins per-attempt hook queue; only outer commit delivers, failed attempts/rollback discard; completed captured contexts fall back rather than reuse closed transactions.
implementation.deployment: No DDL or FK cascade. Stop affected reference/identity/lifecycle/Seed writes across all instances, drain, switch every participant, then resume; rollback also requires stop/drain/full cutover.
